description: This file contains a parser implementation for C++-style header files, specifically designed to extract class, namespace, method, and tag information from source code. It constructs a tree of class data objects representing the structure of parsed files.

classes.name: ScopeType
classes.description: Enumeration for different scope types: CLASS, NAMESPACE, OTHER.

classes.name: MethodData
classes.description: Represents method information including name, return type, parameters, and const qualifier.

classes.name: ClassData
classes.description: Represents class or interface data, including name, namespace, tags, methods, and child classes.

classes.name: InterfaceTree
classes.description: Data structure to hold parsed class/interface hierarchy, supporting namespace and class stack management.

classes.name: Parser
classes.description: Main parser class that reads a file and extracts class, namespace, method, and tag information.

classes.name: Printer
classes.description: Utility class for printing the class hierarchy in a readable format.

methods.name: parseFile
methods.description: Reads the source file and builds the class/interface hierarchy.

methods.name: processTag
methods.description: Extracts tags like 'json' and 'event' from lines.

methods.name: processNamespace
methods.description: Detects namespace declarations and updates the namespace stack.

methods.name: processClass
methods.description: Detects class/struct declarations matching specific pattern and marks pending class.

methods.name: processMethod
methods.description: Identifies virtual method declarations and adds them to the current class.

methods.name: processScope
methods.description: Manages scope stack based on braces, adding classes or namespaces accordingly.

methods.name: extractMethodData
methods.description: Extracts method details from a line of code using regex.
